PAGE_ORDER.finding: The rendered page manifest does not match the controlling packet-set component order. The packet-set manifest orders BCI application (1), optional third-party release (2), cover sheet (3), petition (4), order (5), acceptance (6), consent (7), victim statement (8), reply (9), then guidance (10). Both rendered PDFs instead place petition and order on pages 1-5, cover sheet on 6-7, forms 6-9 on 8-16, and the BCI components last on 17-19.

CLIPPING_AND_OVERLAP.finding: Fresh visual inspection of all 19 canonical and all 19 boundary pages found no clipping or overlap; the admitted whole-family raster receipt independently records 38 pages and zero problems.

FILING_DESTINATION.finding: The instructions name the two destinations in sequence: BCI for the certificate and the Utah district court for the county where the case was heard, including the 180-day transition deadline.

FEE_AND_WAIVER.finding: The unsupported fee assertions are absent. The instructions expressly refuse to publish the court or BCI application amounts as current prices, attribute $150 and $65 only to the exact official forms that visibly print them, direct the participant to the district-court clerk and BCI for current amounts, preserve form 1305GE and BCI indigency-waiver paths, and refuse to infer a certificate-issuance amount for this limitations route.

SERVICE.finding: The instructions name the prosecutor and mail/email methods from the exact held BCI publication, ship the acceptance form, and prohibit completing service facts before service occurs. The build finding preserves the differing coded-track statement as a state-pack fidelity issue rather than silently importing it.

SELF_HELP_STOP.finding: The packet does not state where self-help ends. The route's current committed track has eight stop conditions, including a hard stop for non-US citizens and a stop when a prosecutor or victim objects or the court schedules a hearing. None is presented as a stop; the instructions instead say that if a hearing is scheduled the participant should attend it, directing continued self-help at the exact event the route record says ends it.
